M-DBG-ACCESS.Purpose: Bridge discovered reactive properties to generated refs and public behavior parameters to read-only accessors.

Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Property editing and private-field reflection are excluded.

Requirements.REQ-001: Base Widget slots use Widget.GetProperty; derived slots use their generated public property-ref constructors, cached per PropertyInfo.
Requirements.REQ-002: RefAccessor reads the current slot through IPropertyRef.Get and retains its original category. Parameter accessors read public getters.
Requirements.REQ-003: Dynamic discovery remains a reflection boundary because Widget.GetProperty is nonvirtual and generated Refs have no runtime enumeration API.

Inputs.IN-001: Live Widget and discovered property metadata, or a Behavior parameter.
